search.normalize: lowercase, strip accents/punctuation, split into tokens, THEN collapse doubled vowels (aa->a, ee->e, ii->i, oo->o, uu->u). Example: 'Aamchit' indexes as 'amchit', so query 'amchit' matches. The same function must be applied to the query.
tiers: 1. whole _search or nameAr equals the query
2. ALL query tokens match a token of _search exactly
3. ALL query tokens prefix-match a token of _search
4. ALL query tokens prefix-match a token of _alias
5. ANY query token prefix-matches a token of _search
6. ANY query token prefix-matches a token of _area
search.whyAllTokensFirst: requiring ALL tokens before ANY keeps 'bint jbeil' from matching 'Ghandouriye Bent Jbeil' on the single token 'jbeil' and returning it above the town itself

fields._search: the village's own name (English + Arabic) plus its Arabic name - primary match
fields._alias: alternate spellings of THIS village (CAS/municipality/union + curated exonyms like 'Tyre' -> 'Sour')
fields._area: parent municipality/CAS/union/district - means 'inside this area', rank last
